system.description:
Grants the ability to turn one up to medium-sized or a set of connected non-living objects into another.
Level 1: Transmute object up to 1 kg
Level 2: Transmute object up to 10 kg
Level 3: Transmute object up to 100 kg
Level 4: Transmute objects worth up to 20 CP
Level 5: Transmute objects worth up to 25 CP
Level 6: Transmute objects worth up to 30 CP
